age: Pancreata from 12-week-old male C57BL/6NJR mice (Janvier, Saint Berthewin Cedex, France) or 12-week-old male C57BL/6NTAC mice (Taconic, Lille Skensved, Denmark) were inflated with Liberase (Roche, Hvidovre, Denmark), excised and incubated at 37 °C to allow digestion.
cell_type: In this study we have explored the changes in function, gene and protein expression, and histone modifications in mouse islets exposed to BMP-2, to better understand the mechanism behind BMP-2-induced beta cell dysfunction.
material_type: About 150 intact mouse islets per condition (N = 5) were collected and washed x3 in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
